messages:
rya_sales: Heads up — Pantera Financial procurement wants a single POC assurance bundle they can attach to their vendor file. Ask: SOC 2 Type II evidence, ISO snapshot, and a signed pen-test attestation (explicitly no raw vuln data). They need it by COB Thursday for reviewers. Any objections?

samir_se: No objections. We have a redacted SOC2 PDF, ISO cert scan, and a pen-test exec summary from RedDrill. Procurement said a vendor attestation + remediation summary is fine; they won't accept the full report.

nina_compliance: I can assemble a one-page attestation and an evidence index. Two quick Qs: 1) Do they want engagement dates in the attestation? 2) Any extra language for Private/KMS? Legal will need to sign. I can produce a draft in ~12 hours.

ahmed_engineering: For KMS: use `Customer-managed keys remain in customer VPC; Redwood does not export or persist private keys.` Also add: `Audit logs retained per customer settings; export available on request.` I'll attach a Private-deployment svg.

rya_sales: Procurement also asked whether Dedicated trial pricing differs from hosted for the POC. Keep the packet high level.

kelly_legal: Legal prefers attestation to avoid specific remediation timelines. Recommend: "No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [date]; remediation summary attached." If they request the full RedDrill report, we'll require an executed NDA and handle redaction.

nina_compliance: Draft attestation text I'll use:
```
[Date]
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that an independent penetration test (RedDrill) covering the Redwood inference control plane and related hosting components was completed on [engagement dates]. No unresolved critical findings remain open as of [remediation date]. The full report is restricted; this attestation and the attached remediation summary are provided for vendor assurance purposes.
Sincerely,
Redwood Inference  Compliance
```

samir_se: Procurement DM'd: they do NOT need the full RedDrill report, only attestation + remediation summary + architecture doc. Good to proceed.

evidencebot: Evidence ticket created: EVID-5012 assigned to nina_compliance. Due 1965509999.

nina_compliance: Plan: assemble zip with: 1) SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, 2) ISO27001_cert.jpg, 3) Attestation_draft.pdf (pending Legal), 4) Remediation_summary.pdf, 5) Private_arch_diagram.svg, 6) Pricing_note.txt, 7) One-line telemetry statement. Will upload to secure presign and share short-lived link.

ahmed_engineering: Telemetry line suggestion: `Only aggregated telemetry is collected for performance metrics; customer inputs are not used for model training.`

nina_compliance: Good — adding that. Uploading now to internal presign (expires 7 days). Link (internal): https://internal-s3.redwood.net/presign/EVID-5012/pantera-poc-assurance.zip?exp=7d (do not share publicly).

rya_sales: I'll send the presigned link to Pantera procurement and confirm if they require Legal signatures before download. If they push for the full report, we'll escalate to Legal for NDA/redaction. Thanks team :white_check_mark:

kelly_legal: Noted. Tag Legal Review when attestation is ready. We'll review and sign if wording matches guidance.

nina_compliance: Draft ready; awaiting Legal signature. Will update EVID-5012 status when signed.
